message: Are there any others out there who want to file suit against this company?  I've only been having to deal with it for the past month, but it's been hell.  I've been getting disconnected every couple of calls and found out today that the reason is that i have call waiting on my phone.  The operator told me that I had to have call waiting taken off my phone or it would keep happening.  When I asked why I hadn't been told to do this when I signed up, he said it was on the web site under "To avoid being disconnected."  And, actually, it doesn't say that one has to have it disabled, it just states "Don't use or answer Call Waiting." I've got to get moving on something else this moment but will check back here to see if there are other who want to sue this company.
